Peto Beat Sync uses @nekopaw/tempora 0.4.0-alpha.1 by Makito <i@maki.to>.
Tempora is licensed under Apache License 2.0; see Tempora-LICENSE.txt in this directory.
The published Tempora runtime is bundled without source modifications.
Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@nekopaw/tempora

The architecture and initial analyser settings were informed by Project AIRI:
https://github.com/moeru-ai/airi
The React interface and integration are written for Peto.
beatMotion.ts adapts the sway-sine trajectory and spring from AIRI's
packages/stage-ui-live2d/src/composables/live2d/beat-sync.ts and motion-manager.ts.
Copyright (c) 2024-PRESENT Neko Ayaka. See AIRI-LICENSE.txt (MIT).
Changes: framework-independent offsets, fixed integration substeps, bounded catch-up,
and integration with Peto's independent character effect controls.
